title: EIA-Review-Benchmark Sample Schema
description: Schema for a single benchmark sample in the EIA-Review-Benchmark dataset. Inspired by ELLE-QA Benchmark (Guo et al., 2024) but adapted for EIA report review tasks with evidence traceability requirements.

sample_id.description: Unique sample identifier, format: SAMPLE_{industry_code}_{domain}_{seq}, e.g., SAMPLE_C2929_EXTRACTION_001

source_project_id.description: Reference to the source project in project_index, e.g., P0001

industry_code.description: GB/T 4754-2017 industry classification code (4-digit 小类 level)

industry_name.description: Industry name in Chinese corresponding to the industry code
examples: 塑料零件及其他塑料制品制造

task_domain.description: One of the 14 EIA review task domains

difficulty.description: Difficulty level (ELLE-inspired: Simple/Medium/Hard, with EIA-specific definitions)

question.description: The evaluation question or task prompt presented to the LLM

input_context.description: Source text context needed to answer the question. At least one field should be non-empty.

report_text.description: Relevant excerpt from the EIA report (MinerU-parsed markdown), truncated to relevant section

approval_text.description: Relevant excerpt from the approval decision document (批复文件)

standard_text.description: Relevant clauses from national, provincial, or industry standards

historical_case_context.description: Summary of relevant patterns from historical cases in the same industry (for reasoning tasks)

reference_answer.description: The ground-truth answer. For Simple/Medium tasks, this should be directly verifiable from source text. For Hard tasks or expert-dependent answers, use PLACEHOLDER markers.

expected_evidence.description: Evidence links tracing the answer back to source documents

source_type.description: Type of source document providing the evidence

source_file.description: File name or document identifier for the source

text_span.description: The exact text span in the source that supports the answer

section.description: Section reference within the source (e.g., report section number, standard clause)

reliability.description: Confidence level of the evidence-to-answer link

evaluation_dimensions.description: Expected performance levels on the 4 evaluation dimensions (for LLM-as-a-Judge assessment)

professionalism.description: Expected professionalism level for this sample (guidance for evaluators)

clarity.description: Expected clarity level for this sample

feasibility.description: Expected feasibility of the answer for practical EIA review use

evidence_grounding.description: Whether evidence is available for this sample (key differentiator from general QA benchmarks)

need_human_review.description: Whether this sample requires human expert review. Set to true if: (1) reference_answer contains placeholder, (2) evidence is from expert_judgment, (3) auto-extraction confidence is low

review_notes.description: Notes for human reviewers explaining what needs verification

metadata.description: Optional metadata about sample provenance and quality

created_by.description: Method or person who created the sample

validation_status.description: Current validation status of the sample
